questions.question_english: Which of the following inbound services supplied to an educational institution providing education up to higher secondary level is NOT exempt from GST?

Services relating to admission of students or conduct of examinations
Subscription and supply of online educational journals or periodicals

questions.explanation_english: Under Entry 66(b) of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate), the exempt inbound services supplied to schools up to higher secondary level are strictly enumerated: (i) transportation of students, faculty, and staff; (ii) catering, including mid-day meal schemes; (iii) security, cleaning, or housekeeping services performed within the school; and (iv) services relating to admission or conduct of examination. questions.question_english: If a formal complaint is received regarding the sexual harassment of a minor female student (below 18 years of age) by a male school teacher, under which primary legislation must the police register the First Information Report (FIR)?
options_english: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (POSH) Act, 2013
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
questions.explanation_english:
When a sexual offence is committed against any person below the age of 18 years (defined as a 'child' under Section 2(1)(d) of the POCSO Act), the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012 is the specialized, non-negotiable penal legislation governing the offence.
Although the POSH Act, 2013 covers sexual harassment of women at the workplace, in school settings involving minor students, Section 42A of the POCSO Act clearly provides that POCSO has an overriding effect over other laws in case of any inconsistency. Furthermore, sexual harassment of a child is an offence under Section 11/12 of the POCSO Act (and potentially aggravated sexual assault under Section 9/10 if committed by a person in authority such as a teacher). Therefore, the FIR must be registered under the POCSO Act, 2012 along with relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (formerly IPC).
questions.explanation_hindi:
जब 18 वर्ष से कम आयु के किसी भी बालक/बालिका (पॉक्सो अधिनियम की धारा 2(1)(d) के अनुसार 'बालक') के विरुद्ध कोई लैंगिक अपराध घटित होता है, तो 'लैंगिक अपराधों से बालकों का संरक्षण (POCSO) अधिनियम, 2012' एक विशेष दांडिक विधि के रूप में लागू होता है।
यद्यपि POSH अधिनियम 2013 कार्यस्थल पर महिलाओं की सुरक्षा से संबंधित है, परंतु यदि पीड़िता नाबालिग छात्रा है, तो पॉक्सो अधिनियम की धारा 42A के अध्यारोही प्रभाव (overriding effect) के कारण यह मामला सीधे पॉक्सो अधिनियम के दायरे में आता है। शिक्षक द्वारा नाबालिग छात्रा का उत्पीड़न पॉक्सो की धारा 11/12 (यौन उत्पीड़न) तथा धारा 9/10 (प्राधिकारी व्यक्ति द्वारा गंभीर यौन हमला) के अंतर्गत दंडनीय अपराध है। अतः पुलिस द्वारा FIR अनिवार्य रूप से पॉक्सो अधिनियम, 2012 के तहत दर्ज की जाएगी। इसलिए विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (b) POCSO Act, 2012

questions.question_english:
The National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) has issued regulatory guidelines to eliminate corporal punishment and discrimination in educational institutions. If a teacher forces a child from a disadvantaged group to sit on the floor while other students sit on benches, this discriminatory act constitutes a violation of:
I. Right to Life and Personal Dignity under Article 21 of the Constitution
II. Abolition of Untouchability under Article 17 of the Constitution
III. Anti-discrimination and child rights provisions under the RTE Act, 2009
Which of the following is correct?
options_english: Right to Life and Dignity under Article 21
Article 17 (Abolition of Untouchability)
RTE Act provisions against discrimination
All of the above
questions.explanation_english:
Compelling a child from a disadvantaged group or Scheduled Caste to sit on the floor while other children occupy benches constitutes a grave multifaceted violation of constitutional and statutory law:
1. Article 21 & Article 21A: The Supreme Court has repeatedly held (e.g., in Francis Coralie Mullin and Bandhua Mukti Morcha) that the Right to Life encompasses the right to live with human dignity and freedom from degrading treatment. questions.question_english: In the statutory framework of the POCSO Act, 2012, which of the following circumstances primarily characterizes an offence as an 'aggravated' sexual offence?
options_english: Committing an offence repeatedly against multiple child victims across time
Committing the offence by someone in a position of trust, authority, management, or custody over the child
Committing the offence publicly in a prominent or crowded public place

questions.explanation_english: Under Sections 5 and 9 of the POCSO Act, 2012, an offence of penetrative sexual assault or sexual assault becomes 'aggravated' when committed under circumstances of heightened vulnerability or breach of trust. A primary statutory hallmark of aggravated offences is when the perpetrator is a person in a position of authority, trust, or custody over the child—such as a school principal, teacher, staff member of an educational institution (Section 5(f)/9(f)), police officer, public servant, medical professional, guardian, or relative. Other aggravated categories include offences against children with physical or mental disabilities, during communal or natural calamities, or inflicting grievous bodily harm. Because school personnel occupy a fiduciary position of trust and control over students, sexual abuse committed by staff within educational institutions is legally classified as an aggravated offence, attracting enhanced mandatory minimum sentences.
questions.explanation_hindi: पॉक्सो अधिनियम, 2012 की धारा 5 (गुरुतर प्रवेशन लैंगिक हमला) और धारा 9 (गुरुतर लैंगिक हमला) के तहत किसी अपराध को 'गुरुतर' (Aggravated) तब माना जाता है जब वह विश्वासघात, विशेष अधिकार या बच्चे की अत्यधिक लाचारी की स्थिति में किया गया हो। इसका सबसे प्रमुख सांविधिक आधार यह है कि आरोपी बच्चे पर विश्वास (Trust), प्राधिकार (Authority), प्रबंधन या संरक्षा (Custody) की स्थिति में हो—जैसे कि विद्यालय का प्रधानाचार्य, शिक्षक, स्कूल कर्मचारी (धारा 5(f)/9(f)), पुलिसकर्मी, लोक सेवक, डॉक्टर अथवा अभिभावक। विद्यालय के शिक्षकों और कर्मचारियों द्वारा छात्रों के साथ किया गया लैंगिक अपराध स्वतः 'गुरुतर अपराध' माना जाता है, जिसके लिए कानून में अत्यधिक कठोर न्यूनतम दंड (कठोर आजीवन कारावास या मृत्युदंड तक) का प्रावधान है। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) कहा गया है:

कारण (R): फॉर्म 16 वेतनभोगी कर्मचारियों के लिए स्रोत पर कर कटौती (TDS) को सत्यापित करने और अपने आयकर रिटर्न को सही ढंग से दाखिल करने के लिए अनिवार्य दस्तावेज है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है?

Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
(A) is true, but (R) is false.
(A) is false, but (R) is true.
options_hindi: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
(A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

questions.explanation_english: Under Section 203 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 read with Rule 31 of the Income Tax Rules, every Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) or employer deducting tax at source under Section 192 is statutorily mandated to furnish a certificate of tax deduction in Form 16 to the employee by 15th June of the relevant Assessment Year. Failure to issue Form 16 within the prescribed statutory due date attracts a penalty under Section 272A(2)(g) of the Act (₹500 for every day during which the failure continues). Reason (R) correctly explains why this statutory compulsion exists: Form 16 consists of Part A (TRACES-generated TDS deposit details) and Part B (salary breakdown, exemptions, and Chapter VI-A deductions), which serve as conclusive proof of TDS and enable salaried employees to verify tax credits against Form 26AS/AIS and accurately prepare and file their annual Income Tax Return under Section 139(1). Thus, both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 203 और आयकर नियमावली के नियम 31 के तहत, धारा 192 के अधीन वेतन से स्रोत पर कर कटौती (TDS) करने वाले प्रत्येक आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO)/नियोक्ता का यह वैधानिक दायित्व है कि वह संबंधित कर निर्धारण वर्ष की 15 जून तक कर्मचारी को फॉर्म 16 जारी करे। निर्धारित तिथि तक फॉर्म 16 जारी करने में विफल रहने पर धारा 272A(2)(g) के तहत प्रतिदिन ₹500 का जुर्माना लगाया जाता है। कारण (R) इसकी बिल्कुल सही व्याख्या करता है: फॉर्म 16 (भाग क एवं भाग ख) में कर्मचारी के वेतन, कटौतियों एवं सरकारी खाते में जमा किए गए TDS का प्रामाणिक विवरण होता है, जिसके बिना कर्मचारी 26AS/AIS से मिलान करके धारा 139(1) के तहत अपना आयकर रिटर्न सही-सही दाखिल नहीं कर सकता। अतः (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।

questions.question_english: Which of the following defines the condition for relief under Section 89(1) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 on arrears of salary?
options_english: The employee must be a senior citizen and have no other income from any source
The arrears must be disbursed strictly on the first day of the financial year
The arrears amount must exceed 50% of the employee's basic pay in the current year
The tax payable in the current year on arrears must be higher than the tax that would have been paid had it been received in the respective earlier years
questions.explanation_english: Section 89(1) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 provides relief to salaried employees when salary arrears, advance salary, or family pension arrears are received in a lump sum in a single financial year, pushing the employee into a higher tax bracket. Relief under Section 89(1) (calculated in accordance with Rule 21A) is admissible only if the tax computed on the total income including arrears in the receipt year exceeds the aggregate tax that would have been payable had the arrears been taxed in the respective years to which they pertain. If there is no additional tax burden caused by the lump-sum receipt, relief under Section 89(1) equals zero.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर D है। आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 89(1) (नियम 21A के साथ पठित) के तहत वेतन के बकाए पर राहत तभी प्रदान की जाती है जब बकाए का एकमुश्त भुगतान प्राप्त होने के कारण चालू वित्तीय वर्ष में कर्मचारी पर पड़ने वाला कर भार उस कुल अतिरिक्त कर से अधिक हो, जो बकाया राशि को संबंधित पूर्ववर्ती वर्षों की आय में जोड़कर गणना करने पर बनता। यदि चालू वर्ष में कर दर में कोई वृद्धि नहीं होती है, तो धारा 89(1) के तहत कोई राहत देय नहीं होती।

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): A school collecting transportation fees for ferrying its enrolled students in school buses must charge and collect 18% GST on these fees.
Reason (R): Any service provided by an educational institution to its students, faculty, and staff, including transportation, is exempt from GST under current notifications.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is false: Under Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated June 28, 2017 (Entry 66, Heading 9992), services provided by an educational institution to its students, faculty, and staff are completely exempt from GST. Specifically, transportation of students, faculty, and staff is an exempt educational service. A school cannot levy or collect 18% GST on transportation fees charged to its students.
Reason (R) is true: The GST statutory framework unconditionally exempts core educational and student-support services, including student transportation, catering, and security/cleaning services, provided by educational institutions (up to higher secondary school) to their enrolled students.
Thus, Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) गलत है: केंद्रीय कर (दर) अधिसूचना संख्या 12/2017 (प्रविष्टि 66) के अनुसार, किसी शैक्षणिक संस्थान द्वारा अपने छात्रों, संकाय और कर्मचारियों को प्रदान की जाने वाली सेवाएं वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) से पूर्णतः मुक्त हैं। विद्यालय द्वारा छात्रों से लिए जाने वाले बस परिवहन शुल्क पर 18% GST नहीं लगाया जा सकता।
कारण (R) सही है: GST नियमों के तहत किसी शैक्षणिक संस्थान (विशेषकर उच्चतर माध्यमिक स्तर तक) द्वारा अपने विद्यार्थियों को दी जाने वाली सेवाएं—जैसे परिवहन, भोजन/कैटरिंग, सुरक्षा एवं स्वच्छता सेवाएं—कर-मुक्त सेवाओं की श्रेणी में आती हैं।
अतः अभिकथन (A) गलत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है।

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): If an inadvertent error is discovered in a filed TDS return, such as an incorrect PAN of an employee, the DDO cannot rectify it and the employee permanently loses the tax credit.
Reason (R): The Income Tax Department provides a comprehensive facility through the TRACES portal to file correction/revised TDS statements to rectify bona fide errors.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is completely incorrect: discovering an error (such as an incorrect employee PAN, wrong challan reference, or incorrect deduction amount) in an already submitted quarterly TDS return does NOT mean that the tax credit is forfeited or cannot be fixed. The law allows deductors to file multiple correction statements to rectify errors.
Reason (R) is correct: The Income Tax Department's dedicated TRACES (TDS Reconciliation Analysis and Correction Enabling System) portal provides online and offline utilities enabling DDOs to submit C1 (challan correction), C2 (challan addition), C3 (PAN correction), and other correction statements. Once the DDO submits a correction statement with the valid PAN, the TDS credit is transferred to the employee's Form 26AS/AIS. Hence, (A) is false, but (R) is true.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) पूरी तरह से गलत है: दाखिल किए गए टीडीएस रिटर्न में यदि किसी कर्मचारी का पैन (PAN) गलत दर्ज हो गया हो या अन्य कोई त्रुटि हो, तो कर्मचारी का टैक्स क्रेडिट हमेशा के लिए नष्ट नहीं होता। डीडीओ के पास इसे सुधारने का पूरा विधिक अधिकार होता है।
कारण (R) बिल्कुल सही है: आयकर विभाग अपने ट्रेसेस (TRACES - TDS Reconciliation Analysis and Correction Enabling System) पोर्टल के माध्यम से डीडीओ को ऑनलाइन या कंसोलिडेटेड फाइल डाउनलोड करके शुद्धि विवरणी (Correction Statement - C3 सुधार) दाखिल करने की सुविधा प्रदान करता है। जैसे ही सही पैन अपडेट होता है, टीडीएस क्रेडिट कर्मचारी के फॉर्म 26AS/AIS में प्रदर्शित होने लगता है।
अतः (A) गलत है, लेकिन (R) सही है।

questions.question_english: Which of the following is NOT an essential or appropriate component of creating a child-friendly and safe environment in schools under POCSO guidelines?
options_english: Conducting thorough background checks and police verification for all school staff
Ensuring all identified blind spots in school premises are covered by CCTV surveillance
Banning physical education, sports, and outdoor recreational activities
Conducting regular sensitization sessions on child safety for students and staff members
questions.explanation_english: Under POCSO safety directives and guidelines issued by the Ministry of Education, CBSE, and NCPCR, creating a child-friendly and secure school environment involves structural and behavioral safeguards: thorough police verification and background screening of all staff (Option A), continuous CCTV monitoring of blind spots and unmonitored premises (Option B), and periodic sensitization workshops on safe/unsafe touch and reporting procedures for students, parents, and staff (Option D). In contrast, banning physical education, sports, or outdoor recreational activities (Option C) is completely irrational, counterproductive, and detrimental to children's holistic physical, mental, and social development. Sports are vital to the school curriculum, and safety must be ensured through proper adult supervision and infrastructure rather than prohibiting healthy activities.
questions.explanation_hindi: शिक्षा मंत्रालय, सीबीएसई तथा एनसीपीसीआर द्वारा जारी पॉक्सो सुरक्षा दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार विद्यालय में सुरक्षित व बाल-सुलभ वातावरण निर्मित करने के प्रमुख स्तंभ हैं: सभी शिक्षण एवं गैर-शिक्षण कर्मचारियों (संविदा कर्मियों सहित) का अनिवार्य पुलिस सत्यापन (विकल्प A), परिसर के सभी दृष्टिहीन कोनों (ब्लाइंड स्पॉट्स) और प्रवेश/निकास द्वारों पर सीसीटीवी कैमरे लगाना (विकल्प B), तथा विद्यार्थियों एवं कर्मचारियों के लिए सुरक्षित/असुरक्षित स्पर्श और रिपोर्टिंग तंत्र पर नियमित संवेदीकरण कार्यक्रम आयोजित करना (विकल्प D)। इसके विपरीत, शारीरिक शिक्षा, खेलकूद या पाठ्येतर गतिविधियों पर प्रतिबंध लगाना (विकल्प C) बाल अधिकारों और उनके सर्वांगीण विकास के सर्वथा विपरीत व हानिकारक है। खेल गतिविधियों को रोकना नहीं, बल्कि सुरक्षित पर्यवेक्षण में संचालित करना ही सुरक्षा मानकों का उद्देश्य है। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।

questions.explanation_english: Section 20 of the POCSO Act, 2012 specifically establishes the 'Obligation of media, studio, and photographic facilities to report cases'. It provides that any personnel of media, studio, photographic facilities, or any hotel, lodge, or similar commercial establishment who, in the course of their duties, have knowledge or apprehension that an offence under this Act has been or is likely to be committed, must forthwith provide information to the Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU) or local police. This provision works in tandem with Section 19 (which mandates reporting by any person, including school personnel and hospitals). Crucially, willful failure to discharge this reporting obligation attracts criminal liability under Section 21 of the Act, which prescribes imprisonment of up to six months, or fine, or both (and under Section 21(2), up to one year imprisonment and fine for institutions/companies). This statutory design closes institutional loopholes and ensures child exploitation cannot be hidden behind commercial secrecy.

questions.explanation_english: Under Section 27 of the POCSO Act, 2012 and Section 164A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the medical examination of a child victim of sexual assault must strictly and exclusively be conducted by a registered medical practitioner in a proper hospital/medical setting in accordance with established forensic protocols. The Principal's duties under POCSO, CBSE child safety guidelines, and NCPCR safety manuals are restricted to preventive measures (safety audits, CCTVs, helpline display, student awareness) and mandatory reporting to the Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU) or local police under Section 19.

questions.question_english: In a small cadre consisting of 13 or fewer posts, what is the specialized replacement roster maintained under DoPT guidelines to ensure reservations are allocated without exceeding the constitutional 50% ceiling commonly known as?
options_english: L-shaped roster (14-point roster)
Squeezed cadre roster
Floating vacancy roster
Block compartment roster
questions.explanation_english: Under DoPT OM No. 36012/2/96-Estt (Res) dated 2nd July 1997, maintaining a standard 200-point roster in small cadres containing 1 to 13 posts would cause severe distortion and violate the 50% reservation ceiling laid down in Indra Sawhney. To prevent this, the government devised a specialized 14-point replacement roster, commonly called the "L-shaped roster" (due to its graphical layout with cadre strength on one axis and cycle points on the other). Under this roster, posts are filled successively by replacement, ensuring that at no stage do reserved appointments exceed the permissible constitutional limits.
questions.explanation_hindi: DoPT के 2 जुलाई 1997 के कार्यालय ज्ञापन के अनुसार, 13 या उससे कम पदों वाले छोटे संवर्गों (small cadres) में सामान्य 200-बिंदु रोस्टर लागू करने से आरक्षण 50% की सीमा को पार कर सकता है। इस समस्या के समाधान के लिए सरकार ने 14-बिंदु प्रतिस्थापन रोस्टर तैयार किया जिसे सामान्यतः 'एल-आकार का रोस्टर' (L-shaped roster) कहा जाता है। इसमें संवर्ग संख्या और प्रतिस्थापन चक्र को एल-आकार में व्यवस्थित किया जाता है, जिससे क्रमिक रूप से पदों को भरते समय 50% की सीमा का उल्लंघन नहीं होता है।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following duties of a Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) under Section 192 of the Income Tax Act, 1961:
I. Estimating the total taxable income of the employee under the head 'Salaries' for the financial year.
II. Computing the tax payable on the estimated income at the rates in force.
III. Deducting the computed tax in equal monthly installments from salary payments.
IV. Filing an annual income tax return (ITR) on behalf of each individual employee.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II, and III only
I, III, and IV only
II, III, and IV only
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english:
Statements I, II, and III are correct, while Statement IV is incorrect.

Under Section 192 of the Income Tax Act, 1961, any person responsible for paying salary income must:
1. Estimate the total income of the assessee under 'Salaries' for the financial year (after allowing permissible standard deduction, HRA exemption, and Chapter VI-A deductions).
2. Compute the income-tax payable on such estimated income on the basis of the rates in force for the financial year.
3. Deduct the tax so computed in equal installments during the financial year at the time of each monthly payment.
4. Deposit the deducted tax to the government account and issue Form 16.

Statement IV is incorrect because filing the personal annual Income Tax Return (ITR-1/ITR-2) under Section 139(1) is the exclusive individual responsibility of the employee, not the employer or DDO.
questions.explanation_hindi:
कथन I, II और III सही हैं, जबकि कथन IV गलत है।

आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 192 के तहत, वेतन आय का भुगतान करने के लिए जिम्मेदार व्यक्ति (DDO) को निम्नलिखित कार्य करने होते हैं:
1. वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए 'वेतन' शीर्ष के तहत करदाता की कुल आय का अनुमान लगाना (अनुमेय मानक कटौती, HRA छूट और अध्याय VI-A कटौतियों को शामिल करने के बाद)।
2. वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए लागू दरों के आधार पर ऐसी अनुमानित आय पर देय आयकर की गणना करना।
3. प्रत्येक माह वेतन भुगतान के समय समान किस्तों में इस प्रकार परिकलित कर की कटौती करना।
4. काटे गए कर को सरकारी खाते में जमा करना और फॉर्म 16 जारी करना।

कथन IV गलत है क्योंकि धारा 139(1) के तहत व्यक्तिगत वार्षिक आयकर रिटर्न (ITR-1/ITR-2) दाखिल करना कर्मचारी की अपनी व्यक्तिगत जिम्मेदारी है, न कि नियोक्ता या DDO की।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, II, and III only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Section 192, a Drawing and Disbursing Officer must estimate the employee's annual total income, compute applicable tax liability, and deduct tax in equal monthly installments. However, filing individual income tax returns remains the personal legal duty of the employee and is not part of the employer's statutory responsibilities under this section.
